meta.title: Token usage dashboard
meta.description: Turns session token accounting into a data dashboard. Open any session and pick "Token usage" in the view tab row. Four glass KPI cards up top show total consumed, output, cache-hit rate, and decode TPS, each with a per-turn sparkline; the main panel is a stacked per-turn flow chart (uncached input / cache read / cache write / output) — hover a bar for that turn's exact buckets, first-token latency, TPS, and the models that answered it, with a 20 / 50 / all-turns window switch. A donut gauge reads context occupancy (projected next request ÷ route window) with the approximate system / tools / messages composition; model attribution ranks every provider/model by billed weight with call counts; a timing strip splits the session wall clock into model time, tool time, and gaps. Every figure is read straight from the durable host projections (tokenUsage, sessionStats, contextPressure, contextBreakdown, plus this bundle's tokenPulse unit) — the same source as billing, stable across paging and compaction. Purely presentational: it writes nothing. Disabling the plugin removes the view.
